adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside `createAllCalendarEvents`, for each `destination` with a `credentialId`, the code tries to find the credential in `this.calendarCredentials`, then falls back to a DB lookup and only reconstructs a `credential` if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is truthy. If neither in-memory nor DB reconstruction succeeds, execution falls through without pushing any failed `EventResult` and without logging (it only does `if (credential) { const createdEvent = await createEvent(...); ... }`). This means a destination/host can be silently skipped, resulting in no calendar event and (by implication of downstream reference creation depending on createdEvents) no reference for that host while the booking flow continues.
